title: M&A due diligence — contract red flags

checks.question: Does a change of control or a transfer of shares trigger consent, termination or renegotiation rights?
Can the contract be assigned or transferred (for an asset deal), and is consent required?
Are there exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer or minimum purchase obligations that would bind the buyer group?
When does the contract end, can the counterparty terminate for convenience, and what notice applies?
Is liability uncapped, or are there indemnities or guarantees given by the target?
What is the contract value or volume, and are there take-or-pay or penalty obligations?
Who owns IP created under the contract, and are licences to the target terminable or non-transferable?
Is personal data processed, and is there a compliant data processing agreement?
Which law governs and where are disputes resolved?
Does the document mention pending or threatened disputes, claims or breaches?
